ops.reason: Both rules regulate the dress code for judges; the IPF ban on grey jeans is another version of the same judges' clothing requirement that already includes IPF-originated changes such as black shoes and socks.
The only decision is a rejected proposal to raise the start fee to 350 kr. and allocate part of it as payment to clubs providing judges, which is a pure fee and fee-distribution matter.
The rule sets a condition (BroBizz/Pay by Plate) for reimbursing judges' bridge costs, a reimbursement matter belonging with the mileage allowance rules in okonomi.
